title: Tiny, cute trumpet
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id='bell' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#FFE066'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#FFB302'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id='tube' x1='0' y1='0' x2='1' y2='0'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#FFD23F'/>
      <stop offset='50%' stop-color='#FFE98A'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#F0A500'/>
    </linearGradient>
  </defs>

  <!-- bell flare -->
  <ellipse cx='72' cy='52' rx='22' ry='20' fill='url(#bell)' stroke='#C97A00' stroke-width='2'/>
  <ellipse cx='72' cy='52' rx='14' ry='12' fill='#FFC83D'/>
  <ellipse cx='72' cy='52' rx='7' ry='6' fill='#7A4A00'/>

  <!-- mouthpiece -->
  <ellipse cx='20' cy='44' rx='6' ry='7' fill='#FFF2B0' stroke='#D9A400' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <ellipse cx='20' cy='44' rx='3' ry='3.5' fill='#B98A00'/>

  <!-- main tube --> 
  <path d='M24 45 L44 49 L44 55 L24 51 Z' fill='url(#tube)' stroke='#C97A00' stroke-width='1.5' stroke-linejoin='round'/>

  <!-- tuning slide loop -->
  <path d='M32 51 L32 62 Q32 68 38 68 Q44 68 44 62 L44 55' fill='none' stroke='#E8A200' stroke-width='4' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M32 51 L32 62 Q32 68 38 68 Q44 68 44 62 L44 55' fill='none' stroke='#FFD866' stroke-width='1.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <!-- valve casing -->
  <rect x='50' y='40' width='7' height='22' rx='3' fill='#FFCC33' stroke='#B87900' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <rect x='59' y='40' width='7' height='22' rx='3' fill='#FFCC33' stroke='#B87900' stroke-width='1.5'/>

  <!-- valve caps -->
  <rect x='50' y='36' width='7' height='6' rx='2.5' fill='#FFF0A6' stroke='#B87900' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <rect x='59' y='36' width='7' height='6' rx='2.5' fill='#FFF0A6' stroke='#B87900' stroke-width='1.5'/>

  <!-- valve buttons -->
  <circle cx='53.5' cy='34' r='2.6' fill='#FFE066' stroke='#B87900' stroke-width='1'/>
  <circle cx='62.5' cy='34' r='2.6' fill='#FFE066' stroke='#B87900' stroke-width='1'/>

  <!-- valve stems -->
  <rect x='52.6' y='30' width='1.8' height='4' fill='#FFF2B0'/>
  <rect x='61.6' y='30' width='1.8' height='4' fill='#FFF2B0'/>

  <!-- water key -->
  <line x1='33' y1='62' x2='33' y2='68' stroke='#C97A00' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <circle cx='33' cy='69' r='2' fill='#FFE066' stroke='#B87900' stroke-width='1'/>

  <!-- cute eyes on bell -->
  <circle cx='64' cy='49' r='2.6' fill='#7A4A00'/>
  <circle cx='78' cy='49' r='2.6' fill='#7A4A00'/>
  <circle cx='64.8' cy='48.2' r='0.8' fill='#FFC83D'/>
  <circle cx='78.8' cy='48.2' r='0.8' fill='#FFC83D'/>
  <path d='M68 56 Q71 58.5 74 56' fill='none' stroke='#7A4A00' stroke-width='1.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <circle cx='60' cy='56' r='2' fill='#FF9EB0' opacity='0.7'/>
  <circle cx='82' cy='56' r='2' fill='#FF9EB0' opacity='0.7'/>

  <!-- sparkles -->
  <path d='M86 26 l1.5 4 l4 1.5 l-4 1.5 l-1.5 4 l-1.5 -4 l-4 -1.5 l4 -1.5 Z' fill='#FFFFFF' opacity='0.9'/>
</svg>
